Alex R: Handoff for the latewatch shift — taking over at 23:00 UTC. Primary=Alex R, Secondary=Sanjay. Brief summary below, pls ack when you pick this up.
Oncall Bot: ALERT: high p95 model latency (eu-west) — 47 alerts in the last 10m.
Alex R: Current situation: we started seeing p95 generation latency climb ~3x at 22:10 UTC. Impacting hosted text-gen endpoints in eu-west only. Customer-facing symptoms: increased tail latencies, some timed-out requests (3% of requests in last 20m). No 5xx spike, mostly 504/timeout.
Morgan: Any known deploys?
Alex R: No deploys in the window. No infra changes. Logs point to slow KV cache lookups (redis) and high GPU queueing on the small q4 pool.
Tara: Which runbooks have you followed?
Alex R: Followed /runbooks/latency/eu-west (link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/latency-eu-west). Steps taken:
- Increased dedicated pool for text-gen-eu-west from 4 -> 6 GPUs (allocated reserve capacity). Command used:
```
# scale dedicated pool
infra-cli scale-pool --region eu-west --pool text-gen-dedicated --replicas 6
```
- Enabled fallback routing to quantized variant (q3-small) for non-SLA traffic via routing policy change.
- Throttled large-batch embedding requests (rate limiter) for the region to relieve queue pressure.
- Cleared problematic prefix cache keys for a suspected hot key: `cache:prefix:customer-1138`
Alex R: Immediate mitigation observed: p95 dropped from ~950ms -> ~420ms after scale and throttles. Still above SLO (300ms), so ongoing.
Sanjay: Are we seeing KV timeouts in logs or network saturation?
Alex R: KV timeouts increased from 1% -> 6%, avg latency to redis jumped from 5ms -> 120ms. We opened a ticket with infra (INC-7892-db). They are investigating slow queries on the redis cluster.
Morgan: Is there customer impact to Dedicated/Dedicated customers right now? Any high-priority customers?
Alex R: Two customers on reserved capacity reported slow responses (support ticket #CS-4421). We contacted SE for one to notify them of mitigation steps. No full outages.
Tara: Coverage note — there's a gap 02:00-03:30 UTC where Sanjay is scheduled out for a personal call. Can we patch coverage?
Sanjay: I can extend till 03:00 UTC if needed. If it looks like the redis issue persists beyond 03:00, please escalate to oncall lead (Morgan).
Alex R: Suggested next steps for incoming shift:
1) Monitor p95 and redis errors: Grafana dashboard https://grafana.redwood/d/abc/latency-eu-west (alert muted for noise but watch trend).
2) If p95 > 700ms for >15m, run scaled rollback: reduce q3 fallback and increase backends to 8 GPUs, then re-evaluate.
3) If redis timeouts >8%, follow DB runbook (https://runbooks.internal/redwood/db/redis-high-latency) — short-term: enable read-replicas and divert non-critical reads.
4) If customer impact grows, trigger paging for ENG-SRE and Customer Success (pager template: /ops/pagers/latency-high).
Alex R: Commands and checks I used (paste for next oncall):
```
# check queue lengths
infra-cli pool-stats --pool text-gen-dedicated --region eu-west
# view redis slow logs
redis-cli -h redis-euw-001 slowlog get 50
# change routing policy to fallback
apictl routing update --region eu-west --service text-gen --policy fallback:q3-small
```
Ops Pager: Pager created for threshold breach at 23:05 UTC — ID PGR-1123.
Morgan: I'll take the next 2 hours remote watch — can follow handoff if things stay stable. If p95 starts trending back up, I'll execute the read-replica diversion.
Tara: Noted. Also add a short-term notification to CS so they can pre-empt customers. Action: Alex to post one-line status to #customer-success.
Alex R: Posted a short update: "We are mitigating elevated generation latency in eu-west; scaling and routing fallback in progress. No downtime, reducing tail latency; CS team monitoring."
Sanjay: I'll be reachable via DM and can jump in if paging escalates.
Alex R: Handoff checklist: 
- Ongoing alerts: model-latency-eu-west (firing), redis-timeout-eu-west (firing)
- Mitigations in progress: scaled GPUs 4->6, routing fallback enabled, embedding throttles applied
- Known gaps: 02:00-03:30 UTC limited secondary coverage (Sanjay extended to 03:00)
- Runbooks: latency/eu-west, db/redis-high-latency, paging template link above
Alex R: Please ack once you have the channel and I'll sign off.
Morgan: Ack — watching. I'll escalate if thresholds breach.
Tara: Acked. Leaving notes in the incident doc as well.
Oncall Bot: Handoff recorded by Alex R at 23:02 UTC.
Alex R: Leaving now — thanks all.
Morgan: Thanks, have a good rest.
